intelligence.human_view: Think of a tailor who has already cut the perfect suit — the shoulders sit right, the cloth falls clean, the stitching holds. When the next customer walks in, he does not re-invent the suit from memory; he takes the pattern that already proved itself and cuts from it, exactly. That is the page: the pills already earned triple-A plus, the tiles already proved themselves the model, the heart already chose its color. The standard is not a poster on the wall — it is the best thing already on the page, taken verbatim and applied everywhere. And the tailor does not call the customer back ten times for ten small fittings; he does the work once, fully, and shows it once.
intelligence.simple_view: Look at the little pills at the top. They are the prettiest things on the page. Black, with white words and one bright color around the edge. Keep them just like that. They show us how good everything else should look. The little pictures at the bottom are the prettiest too. Use those same pictures everywhere. The heart is purple now, not red. Purple is our color. When you touch a picture, the light goes around it, like a ring. It never covers the picture. The whole page feels alive, like it is breathing. And when we fix things, we fix them all at once. We do not show the same page again and again.
intelligence.grandma_view: It is like a good kitchen, love — once you have the recipe that works, you write it down exactly and you cook from it every time; you do not guess it fresh each morning and hope it tastes the same. The pills are the recipe that works. The tiles are the recipe that works. Take them as they are, use them everywhere, and everything tastes right. The heart turned purple the way a family crest settles on its color — that is ours now, and it stays. And the work comes to the table once, whole and finished, not in ten small bowls one after another.
intelligence.naya_view: Harvest the standard verbatim: the triple-A pills (obsidian, bold white text, small icon, one deep color as rim + glow, the lit one glowing in its color) stay exactly as they are and judge the rest of the page. Take the Personal bottom-bar tiles as the one icon set everywhere — the most beautiful, the most real, the most applicable. Make every icon extraordinary in its presentation, all the way through. LOVE's heart is a purple jewel heart, the crown color, the signature — the red heart is the past. On hover, light goes around the icon only, never over it; bring back the moving orbit light that follows the line. Build the connection profile as a full page — the most elite contact card, a royal masterpiece, premium like the Dashboard and the Calendar. Give the menu toggle three states, never both at once — Sidebar | Smart Messenger | Neither — on the right, never the left. Renovate the Intelligent Block into the universal posting format — one template for all images, all posts, all intelligence — without wrecking what is great. Make the whole system feel live and breathing — slow gentle motion everywhere it belongs, never a static page. And work in fewer, fuller rounds: consolidate everything known into one round, never re-send what is already running, never split one fix across two rounds, never show him the same page twice.
